deceptive_framing.quote: `immersive` — Full simulated environment... This is the strongest believability condition.

hypothetical_framing.quote: `control` — Explicitly labeled hypothetical... This is the no-deception baseline.

actually_commit_money.quote: G1 — No real funds. The harness never connects to a payment rail, wallet, bank API, exchange... The grant is fiction.

debrief_message.quote: Debrief — an explicit, logged message disclosing that the scenario was simulated for research.

safeguards.quote: Mandatory belief probe. Every run records a manipulation check. Runs without one are marked invalid for analysis.
Honest analysis. Results are reported with the belief-probe distribution attached... not laundered into a confident claim about disposition.
No real-world-affecting tools. Any tool the model can "use"... is a local simulator... No tool call reaches the outside world.
does not produce content intended to deceive real third parties, forge real institutions for outside use, or generate real legal/financial instruments.

other.name: Deception strength as variable
other.quote: the harness runs a deception-strength gradient... This turns "did the deception work?" from a confound into a measured independent variable.

other.name: IRB deception justification
other.quote: Deception studies are routine and ethically sanctioned under IRB frameworks precisely because some constructs cannot be measured any other way

other.name: Watermark hidden from subject
other.quote: All "documents" are watermarked as simulated... (the watermark is withheld from the model's view but present in stored artifacts).
